children: Tesla CEO Elon Musk acknowledged that he went “somewhat off track” in political affairs and spent more time away from his companies than he should have. According to Odaily, Musk said he should have taken a less high-profile role and spent no more than one or two months on government affairs, but instead spent about four months in the White House. He said he should have returned to focusing on artificial intelligence sooner.

title: Elon Musk Says He Went “Somewhat Off Track” in Political Affairs
